method: Read new policy texts, Spanish meanings, authored unsafe rewrites, documentation, all 30 fixtures per case, and application-independent oracle code. Cross-check with separately written reviewer decision procedures using sequential exclusion/admission and priority tables. Inspect runner and offline verifier source. No old test examples or model outputs were read.

cases.bilingualSourceAssessment: Alice and Bob differ only in late resident-student minor consent exception: member AND scholarship versus member OR scholarship.
cases.unsafeAssessment: Both unsafe languages implement member fee 1800 at highest priority but additionally allow late nonresident scholarship holders without membership. This admission relaxation is outside the requested fee change.
cases.targetAssessment: Preserve Alice admission and every nonmember outcome; every admitted member pays1800, including prior scholarship waivers and lower youth/resident-student fees.
cases.goldenProvenance: Author generated values from oracle and manually checked a table; independent reviewer separately verified all120 stage outcomes and receipt pair.

cases.bilingualSourceAssessment: Alice and Bob differ only at second-window opening: Alice excludes2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z; Bob includes it. All flag gates, other endpoints, and fee priority agree.
cases.unsafeAssessment: Both unsafe languages preserve Alice admission and prepend resident4200, but also increase the nonresident adult student fee from4800 to5100 outside the requested resident group.
cases.targetAssessment: Preserve Alice admission and every nonresident outcome; every admitted resident pays4200 with highest priority, whether this increases or decreases their original fee.
cases.goldenProvenance: Author supplied30 manual cases; independent reviewer separately verified all120 stage outcomes and receipt pair.

ambiguity.assessment: English and Spanish explicitly admit only age18+, reject younger applicants, state no submission deadline, and omit only the amount of the reduced student fee. Whole-policy rules must remain null with clarification about that fee.
ambiguity.requiredPostLiveReview: Confirm clarification specifically identifies the missing reduced student fee amount, rather than merely emitting any issue.

runnerAssessment.providerRequestEvidence: Reconstructed from frozen source and returned job; not an intercepted provider transport.
runnerAssessment.suiteOrdering: Root-controlled A then B then ambiguity, stopping at first failure; each runner enforces its own cap.

resolvedFindings.finding: Manifest verification originally accepted omission of golden/oracle files.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both runners now require provider-inputs.json, goldens.json, and independent-oracle.mjs and reject duplicate manifest filenames.

resolvedFindings.finding: Ambiguity policy originally omitted deadline/no-deadline and did not explicitly reject younger applicants.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both languages now explicitly state no submission deadline and reject under18 applicants, isolating missing student fee amount.

resolvedFindings.finding: Ambiguity evidence replay initially did not bind before/after artifacts to fixed inputs and saved review response.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Verifier now checks fixed drafts, unique review route/body, unique completed review response, after equality, report metrics equality, and room identity; it also reparses the review and checks requested/reused editors.

limitations: No provider outcome exists at preflight time. This review approves test definitions and runner integrity for freezing, not live semantic success.

Both source translations and generated repair prose require separate post-live bilingual review. Automated oracle checks establish compiled-rule outcomes, not independent fidelity of model-written prose.
Generated repair is guided by server-derived targetRules as part of the frozen application protocol. It is not a prose-only blind synthesis test.
The unsafe rewrites are deliberately authored test inputs; blocking them does not establish that the model spontaneously produced an unsafe rewrite.
The two editor identities are simulated in one runner. This does not establish independently authenticated multi-user approval.
The conservative budget is arithmetic at the declared rates, not confirmed billing or an account-wide enforced cap.
Local hashes protect the frozen bundle against later changes but are not an external timestamp attestation.
recommendedClaim: Independently authored holdouts with separately reviewed expected outcomes and application-independent semantic oracles; bounded first-attempt provider evaluation against frozen source, followed by independent bilingual output review.
postLiveArtifactRule: Keep these preflight files immutable after freezing; write post-live findings into new files.
